title: pentameris angulata
intro: Pentameris angulata, commonly known as the Red-stemmed Needle-grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is a perennial plant with a wide distribution, primarily found in the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The Red-stemmed Needle-grass has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that may exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
